claude_proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect in spell Effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Geas applies the Charmed condition on a failed WIS save. Spell Effect is currently DamageEffect | NoneEffect — there is no apply_condition variant for spells. The mastery surface has apply_condition in SaveGateRiderResult, but that type is not reachable from spell ActivationPhase.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Slot-threshold Duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Geas duration jumps at slot thresholds: 30 days (L5), 365 days (L7–8), and 'lasts until ended by Remove Curse / Greater Restoration / Wish' (L9, effectively permanent). Duration only has instantaneous, concentration, and timed — no slot-threshold variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you use a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the duration is 365 days. If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.
